data.display_address: Falls, Haven by Aldar, Dubai Land, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience modern living in the heart of Aldar Haven with this beautifully designed 3-bedroom townhouse in The Falls community. Boasting spacious interiors, contemporary finishes, and abundant natural light, this home is perfect for families seeking comfort and convenience.

Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 3
Size: 1,825 sq. ft.
Key Features: Open-plan living and dining area, fully equipped modern kitchen, en-suite master bedroom, private terrace, and garden.

Located in a serene and family-friendly neighborhood, this townhouse offers easy access to retail, dining, and entertainment options within Aldar Haven. Ideal for those looking for a stylish and practical home in a vibrant community.

Community Amenities:

Haven by Aldar is designed around wellness and active living, offering:

-Resort-Style Swimming Pool
-Fully Equipped Gymnasium
-Landscaped Parks & Green Corridors
-Jogging & Cycling Tracks
-Kids’ Play Areas
-Community Retail & Cafés
-Gated Community with 24/7 Security

Location Highlights:

Dubai Land provides excellent connectivity while offering a peaceful suburban atmosphere:

-Easy Access to Emirates Road & Al Ain Road
-20–25 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
-Close to Global Village
-Near Reputable Schools & Healthcare Facilities
-Growing Community with Strong Investment Potential
